sunflowers.title: Sunflowers
sunflowers.text: Van Gogh painted sunflowers multiple times. Which one speaks to you?

1888: You chose a Sunflowers painting from 1888.
This version was painted in Arles, during a period of hope and anticipation.
Van Gogh used bright yellows and fuller flowers to express warmth and friendship.
1889: You chose a Sunflowers painting from 1889.
This version was painted in Arles, during a period of hope and anticipation.
Van Gogh used bright yellows and fuller flowers to express warmth and friendship.

bedroom.title: Bedroom in Arles
bedroom.text: Van Gogh painted his bedroom three times. Which room feels more peaceful to you?

1888: This was the original painting of his room in Arles.
Bold colors and simplified shapes were meant to create a sense of rest and calm.
1889: This was the original painting of his room in Arles.

chairs.text: Van Gogh painted two chairs. Each one represents a different personality. Which one feels more present to you?
